newsitem.title: USA: PHLX examines Alex Brown option trading-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: PHLX examines Alex Brown option trading-WSJ.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) is conducting a "routine" inquiry into unusual trading activity of Alex. Brown options before a takeover of the company by Bankers Trust was announced, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
According to people close to the process, the exchange is looking at large purchases of call options on Alex. Brown shares, the newspaper said.

People familiar with the Securities and Exchange Commission's enforcement policies also said the agency usually investigated unusual trading in a stock before the announcment of market-moving news, the Journal said.
Alex. Brown Chairman A.B. Krongard was quoted in the newspaper as saying on a conference call about the deal: "Will there be an investigation? My guess is it is going on as we speak, automatically."
Bankers Trust Chairman Frank Newman was quoted in the paper as saying there were no "allegations of market improprieties" in conversations with different regulatory authorities last week.
Neither exchange was immediately available to comment.
